Incoming mysterious enemies!|Beginning of Wave 16 ([[Golden Mode|Golden]] & [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}}}} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Ultra Mystery''' was a mysterious enemy that was quite fast, being slightly slower than the [[Ninja]], and it also had average health for its debut. It could be quite dangerous considering that, upon its death, it spawned a random enemy. The '''Ultra Mystery''' spawned either the [[Abnormal]], [[Quick]], [[Heavy]], [[Ninja]], or [[Abnormal Boss]] upon its death. In [[Polluted Wasteland]], it spawned the [[Radioactive]] instead of the [[Heavy]] and the [[Wasted Boss]] instead of the [[Abnormal Boss]]. The '''Ultra Mystery''' used to appear in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] and [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] modes. It has since been replaced by the [[Mystery]]. ==Appearance== The '''Ultra Mystery''' was a translucent, glossy yellow enemy with a glowing white question mark on its torso. It had a drooling zombie face and white glowing eyes. ==Strategy== *Like other mystery enemies, you should prepare to deal with the enemies that spawn from the '''Ultra Mystery''', especially the [[Ninja]] and [[Abnormal Boss]]. **In [[Polluted Wasteland]], '''Ultra Mysteries''' are capable of spawning [[Wasted Boss]]es and [[Radioactive]]s, which can pose as a major threat. **In this scenario, you should bring high DPS towers such as the [[Minigunner]] or [[Ranger|Outlaw]] to counter this. *The [[Archer|Holiday Archer]] helps the most against the '''Ultra Mystery''', as they can kill multiple enemies, so long they are in a straight line. *The [[Gladiator]] can hit the '''Ultra Mystery''' and the enemy they spawn if it is lucky enough. *The enemies that spawn from the '''Ultra Mystery''' do not need to be killed for wave progression to occur. **Due to this, if you are speedrunning a map, you should focus on killing the '''Ultra Mysteries''' first before moving onto the enemies that spawn. *Splash damage towers, like the [[Demoman]], [[Mortar]] and [[Rocketeer]], can clear out hordes of '''Ultra Mysteries''' relatively quickly. *If there are some '''Ultra Mysteries''' at the end of the path with low health, do not kill them as they may turn into [[Abnormal Boss]]es, doing considerably more damage to the base. ==Trivia== *The '''Ultra Mystery''' had a similar appearance to the second version of the [[Super Mystery|Mystery 2]]. *The question mark on the '''Ultra Mystery''' is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|1028826|Question Mark}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **'''Ultra Mystery''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Ultra Mystery''' upon death has a chance to not disappear, instead it will have negative health and continue walking, stopping when it reaches a turn or the exit. Increases base health if it reaches the exit. *'''4 March 2020''' - [[Release v1.8|Release v1.8.0]] **[[Abnormal Boss]] spawnrate increased. *'''29 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.10|Release v1.10.0]] **'''Ultra Mystery''' now spawns the [[Radioactive]] instead of the [[Heavy]] and the [[Wasted Boss]] instead of the [[Abnormal Boss]] in [[Polluted Wasteland]]. *'''26 May 2020''' - [[Release v1.11|Release v1.11.0]] **'''Ultra Mystery''' removed, replaced with [[Mystery]]. {{Golden|[[Ninja]]|Wave 13|Ultra Mystery|Wave 16 (Former)|[[Dark Necromancer]]|Wave 19}} {{LegacyFallen|[[Ninja]]|Wave 13|Ultra Mystery|Wave 16 (Former)|[[Dark Necromancer]]|Wave 19}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
